    ((∀ a, 3 ≤ (nbrR a).card) ∧ (∀ c, 3 ≤ (nbrC c).card) ∧

changed.title: A polynomial Boolean circuit recovers weighted boundary histograms and indexed boundary words from two-site histograms
changed.statement:
∃ C : ℕ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (n m t b : ℕ), 0 < t →
  let I := Fin n
  let T := Fin t
  let E := Fin m
  let J := Fin (m+1)
  let d := n+m*b+1
  let N := 2+(1+t*t)*(m+1)^3*d+2*t+t*t+3*(m+1)+d
  ∃ (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit)
    (count : J → J → J → Fin d → Fin (N+g.size))
    (flag : Fin (N+g.size)) (word : T → Fin (N+g.size)),
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack N g ∧ g.size ≤ (n+m+t+b+2)^C ∧
    (∀ gate ∈ g.gates, ((gate.op = .and ∨ gate.op = .or) ∧ gate.inputs.length = 2) ∨
       (gate.op = .not ∧ gate.inputs.length = 1)) ∧
    ∀ (u v : E → I) (pin : T ↪ I),
    let G := Option I
    let edge := fun x y : I => ∃ e : Fin m, (u e = x ∧ v e = y) ∨ (u e = y ∧ v e = x)
    let adj := fun x y : I => decide (edge x y)
    let rim := fun i : I => decide (∃ j, pin j = i)
    let inc := fun (x y : G) => x.elim (y.elim false rim) (fun i => y.elim (rim i) (adj i))
    (∀ e, u e ≠ v e) → (∀ i j : I, Relation.ReflTransGen edge i j) →
    (∃ (l : ℕ) (src dst : Fin l → G) (rot rev : Equiv.Perm (Fin l)) (spoke : T → Fin l),
      Function.Injective (fun d => (src d,dst d)) ∧
      (∀ x y : G, inc x y = true ↔ ∃ d, src d = x ∧ dst d = y) ∧
      (∀ d, src (rev d) = dst d ∧ dst (rev d) = src d ∧ src (rot d) = src d) ∧
      (∀ d e, src d = src e → ∃ j : ℕ, (rot^j) d = e) ∧
      (∀ i, src (spoke i) = none ∧ dst (spoke i) = some (pin i) ∧
        ∀ j : T, j.val = (i.val+1) % t → rot (spoke i) = spoke j) ∧
      let walk := fun d : Fin l => rot (rev d)
      let faces := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin l)).image (fun d =>
        (Finset.range l).image (fun j => walk^[j] d))
      2*(n+1)+2*faces.card = 4+l) →
    ∀ (w : E → Bool → Fin (2^b)) (color : E → Fin 3)
        (per : T → Bool → Bool) (order : Equiv.Perm T) (a y z : J) (index : Fin (2^d)),
      let raw := fun (x : I → Bool) (l r h : J) =>
        let diff := fun e : E => xor (x (u e)) (x (v e))
        let tally := fun j : Fin 3 => (Finset.univ.filter (fun e : E => color e = j ∧ diff e = true)).card
        if tally 0 = l.val ∧ tally 1 = r.val ∧ tally 2 = h.val then ∏ e, (w e (diff e)).val else 0
      let obs := fun (P : Finset T) (l r h : J) => ∑ x : I → Bool,
        if ∀ i ∈ P, x (pin i) = false then raw x l r h else 0
      let bits := fun (v' : ℕ) => List.ofFn (fun i : Fin d => v'.testBit i.val)
      let block := fun (P : Finset T) => (List.ofFn (fun l : J => (List.ofFn (fun r : J =>
        (List.ofFn (fun h : J => bits (obs P l r h))).flatten)).flatten)).flatten
      let pairs := (List.ofFn (fun i : T => (List.ofFn (fun j : T => block (if i = j then ∅ else {i,j}))).flatten)).flatten
      let mask := (List.ofFn (fun i : T => [per i false,per i true])).flatten
      let perm := (List.ofFn (fun i : T => List.ofFn (fun j : T => decide (order i = j)))).flatten
      let hot := fun (i : J) => List.ofFn (fun j : J => decide (i = j))
      let ws := g.wires ([false,true] ++ block ∅ ++ pairs ++ mask ++ perm ++ hot a ++ hot y ++ hot z ++ bits index.val)
      let mass := fun (l r h : J) (x : I → Bool) =>
        if ∀ i : T, per i (x (pin i)) = true then raw x l r h else 0
      let code := fun (x : I → Bool) => ∑ i : T, (x (pin (order i))).toNat * 2^(t-1-i.val)
      let picked := ∑ i : T, (ws.getD (word i).val false).toNat * 2^(t-1-i.val)
      (∀ l r h, (∑ j : Fin d, (ws.getD (count l r h j).val false).toNat*2^j.val) =
        ∑ x : I → Bool, mass l r h x) ∧
      ws.getD flag.val false = decide (index.val < ∑ x : I → Bool, mass a y z x) ∧
      if index.val < ∑ x : I → Bool, mass a y z x then
        (∑ x : I → Bool, if code x < picked then mass a y z x else 0) ≤ index.val ∧
        index.val < (∑ x : I → Bool, if code x ≤ picked then mass a y z x else 0)
      else picked = 0

changed.title: A fan-in-two circuit finds a largest raw-key flat with bounded joint quadratic span in both cyclic updates
changed.statement:
∀ (k m b h : Nat) (hk : 0 < k),
  let F := ZMod 2
  let W := Fin k → F
  let ix := fun s : Nat => (⟨s % k, Nat.mod_lt _ hk⟩ : Fin k)
  let rot := fun (s : Nat) (w : W) (j : Fin k) => w (ix (j.val+k-s % k))
  let run := fun (col : Bool) (name c key : W) (j : Fin k) =>
    let d := if col then 2 else 1
    let z := rot (if col then 3 else 1) key + name
    let y := fun i : Fin k => z i + z (ix (i.val+d)) + z (ix (i.val+k-d % k))
    y j + (1+y (ix (j.val+1)))*y (ix (j.val+2)) +
      rot (if col then 4 else 0) key j + c j
  let inputs := (m+2)*k
  let bitsN := Nat.log2 k + 1
  let H := min h (2*k)
  let B := min b k
  ∃ (A : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (ok : Fin (inputs+A.size))
    (rowWire : Fin k → Fin k → Fin (inputs+A.size))
    (dimWire : Fin bitsN → Fin (inputs+A.size)),
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo A ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack inputs A ∧
    A.output = ok.val ∧
    A.size ≤ 2^(128*(B+H+20)^3)*(k+m+5)^16 ∧
    ∀ (Q : Fin m → W) (marked : Bool → Fin k → Bool),
      let pack := fun w : W => List.ofFn (fun j : Fin k => decide (w j ≠ 0))
      let bits := (List.ofFn (fun i => pack (Q i))).flatten ++
        List.ofFn (marked false) ++ List.ofFn (marked true)
      let wire := fun i : Fin (inputs+A.size) => (A.wires bits).getD i.val false
      let out := fun i j => (if wire (rowWire i j) then 1 else 0 : F)
      let K := Submodule.span F (Set.range out)
      let nz := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k)).filter (fun i => out i ≠ 0)
      let dim := Module.finrank F K
      let obs := {u : Bool × Fin k // marked u.1 u.2 = true}
      let admissible := fun (U : Submodule F W) =>
        (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ i : Fin m, dotProduct (Q i) x = 0) ∧
        (∀ (name c : Bool → W) (a : W),
          let polar := fun (u : obs) (xy : U × U) =>
            let probe := run u.val.1 (name u.val.1) (c u.val.1)
            probe a u.val.2 + probe (a+xy.1.val) u.val.2 +
              probe (a+xy.2.val) u.val.2 + probe (a+xy.1.val+xy.2.val) u.val.2
          Module.finrank F (Submodule.span F (Set.range polar)) ≤ h)
      (wire ok = true ↔ Module.finrank F (Submodule.span F (Set.range Q)) ≤ b) ∧
      (wire ok = true →
        admissible K ∧ (∀ U : Submodule F W, admissible U → Module.finrank F U ≤ dim) ∧
        LinearIndependent F (fun i : ↥nz => out i.val)) ∧
      (wire ok = false → ∀ i, out i = 0) ∧
      (∀ j : Fin bitsN, wire (dimWire j) = dim.testBit j.val)

changed.title: Feasible positive triples using each name twice encode a permanent in counts of optimal fan-in-two AND/OR equality functions
changed.statement:
let header := fun n : Nat => List.replicate n true ++ [false]
let frame := fun xs : List Bool => xs.flatMap (fun b => [true,b]) ++ [false]
let field := fun (k z : Nat) => (List.range (k.log2+1)).map (fun i => z.testBit i)
let fast := fun f : List Bool → List Bool =>
  ∃ M : Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) f,
    ∀ i, Finite (M.tm.Γ i)
∃ write read residue : List Bool → List Bool, fast write ∧ fast read ∧ fast residue ∧
  ∀ (n : Nat), 0 < n → ∀ A : Fin n → Fin n → Bool,
    let v := 2*n
    let e := fun h : Nat => 2*(n+h)
    let q := fun h : Nat => 2*e h+1
    let cells := (List.finRange n).flatMap (fun i => (List.finRange n).map (fun j => (i,j)))
    let B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Nat := fun i j => (A i j).toNat
    let mat := cells.toFinset.powerset.filter (fun S =>
      (∀ z ∈ S, A z.1 z.2 = true) ∧ (S.image Prod.fst).card = S.card ∧
      (S.image Prod.snd).card = S.card)
    let m := fun r : Nat => (mat.filter (fun S => S.card = r)).card
    let I := fun j : Nat => Nat.card {P : Equiv.Perm (Fin j) // Function.Involutive P}
    let links := fun h : Nat =>
      let port := fun (block j : Nat) => block*q h +
        (if j = 0 then 0 else if j = e h+1 then 2*e h else 2*j-1)
      cells.flatMap (fun z =>
        let l := port z.1.val (2*z.2.val)
        let l' := port z.1.val (2*z.2.val+1)
        let r := port (n+z.2.val) (2*z.1.val)
        let r' := port (n+z.2.val) (2*z.1.val+1)
        if A z.1 z.2 then [(l,r),(l',r')] else [(l,l'),(r,r')]) ++
      (List.range v).flatMap (fun u => (List.range (h+1)).map (fun j =>
        (port u (2*n+2*j),port u (2*n+2*j+1))))
    let size := fun h : Nat => v*q h+2*(links h).length
    let rows := fun h : Nat =>
      (List.range v).flatMap (fun u => (List.range (e h)).map (fun j =>
        let b := u*q h+2*j
        [b,b+1,b+2])) ++ (links h).zipIdx.flatMap (fun z =>
          let b := v*q h+2*z.2
          [[b,b+1,z.1.1],[b,b+1,z.1.2]])
    let Z := fun h : Nat => let k := size h
      let Fn := (Fin k → Bool) → (Fin k → Bool) → Bool
      Nat.card {f : Fn // (∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
        PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size+1 ≤ 2*k ∧
        PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun i j : Fin k => decide (i=j)) C ∧
        ∀ x y, f x y = C.eval (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn y)) ∧
        ∀ R ∈ rows h, f (fun i => decide (i.val ∈ R)) (fun _ => false) = true}
    (∀ h : Nat, write (header n ++ header h ++ cells.map (fun z => A z.1 z.2)) =
      header (size h) ++ (rows h).flatMap (fun R => R.flatMap (field (size h))) ∧
      ((rows h).map List.toFinset).Nodup ∧
      (∀ R ∈ rows h, R.length = 3 ∧ R.Nodup ∧ ∀ u ∈ R, u < size h) ∧
      (∀ u : Fin (size h), ((rows h).filter (fun R => decide (u.val ∈ R))).length = 2) ∧

changed.statement:
∀ (k r m q s d : Nat), 4 ≤ r → 2 ≤ q → 0 < s → k = q*s → s ≤ d → d < 2*s →
  let u := d-s
  let rot := fun (h w : Nat) =>
    ((w <<< (h % k)) ||| (w >>> (k - h % k))) % 2^k
  let step := fun (w : Nat) =>
    (List.range k).foldl (fun acc i => acc ||| ((xor (w.testBit i)
      (!(w.testBit ((i+1)%k)) && w.testBit ((i+2)%k))).toNat <<< i)) 0
  let state := fun (col : Bool) (w name : Nat) (c : Fin r → Fin (2^k)) =>
    let g := if col then 2 else 1
    (List.finRange r).foldl (fun x j =>
      step (x ^^^ rot g x ^^^ rot (k-g) x) ^^^
        rot (if col then 3*(j.val+1)+1 else 2*j.val) w ^^^ (c j).val)
      (rot (if col then 3 else 1) w ^^^ name)
  let reach := fun col : Bool => if col then 7*r-2 else 5*r-3
  let delay := fun col : Bool => if col then 3*r+1 else 2*r-2
  let sign := fun b : Bool => if b then (-1 : ℤ) else 1
  let bits := fun (a x : Nat) => (List.range a).map (fun i => x.testBit i)
  let sched := fun (c : Fin r → Fin (2^k)) =>
    (List.finRange r).flatMap (fun j => bits k (c j).val)
  ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (3*k+2*r*k+q+m*q+m+(k+1)) C ∧
    C.size ≤ 2^44*(k+r+m+5)^16*(2^(s-1+u)+2^(3*u)) ∧
    ∀ (nr nc : Fin (2^k)) (cr cc : Fin r → Fin (2^k)) (off : Fin k) (bank : Fin q → Bool),
      let p := fun i : Fin q => (off.val+i.val*s)%k
      let sensor := fun (i : Fin q) (w : Nat) =>
        (state (bank i) w (if bank i then nc.val else nr.val)
          (if bank i then cc else cr)).testBit ((p i + delay (bank i))%k)
      let valid := ∀ i, reach (bank i) ≤ d
      let K := fun (i : Fin q) (a b : Fin (2^u)) =>
        ∑ z : Fin (2^(s-1)),
          if z.val % 2^u = a.val then
            let h := fun (t : Bool) => sensor i (rot (p i)
              ((z.val <<< 1) ||| (t.toNat <<< s) ||| (b.val <<< (s+1))))
            if h false = h true then (0 : ℤ) else sign (h false)
          else 0
      let D := Matrix.trace ((List.ofFn
        (fun i : Fin q => (K i : Matrix (Fin (2^u)) (Fin (2^u)) ℤ))).prod)
      (valid → ∀ y : Fin q → Bool,
        ((Nat.card {w : Fin (2^k) // ∀ i, sensor i w.val = y i}) : ℤ) =

        let obs := fun (w : Nat) (j : Fin m) => (List.finRange q).foldl
          (fun b i => xor b ((A j).val.testBit i.val && sensor i w)) false
        let hits := Nat.card {w : Fin (2^k) // ∀ j, obs w.val j = v j}
        let masks := (List.finRange m).flatMap (fun j => bits q (A j).val)
        C.eval (bits k nr.val ++ bits k nc.val ++ sched cr ++ sched cc ++ bits k off.val ++
          List.ofFn bank ++ masks ++ List.ofFn v ++ bits (k+1) t.val) =
            decide (valid ∧ t.val ≤ hits)

changed.statement:
∀ n m : Nat, 3 ≤ n → 3 ≤ m →
  let good := fun A : Fin n → Fin m → Bool =>
    let lr := fun i k : Fin n => ∀ j, A i j = true → A k j = true
    let lc := fun j l : Fin m => ∀ i, A i j = true → A i l = true
    Function.Injective A ∧ Function.Injective (fun j i => A i j) ∧
    (∀ i, ∃ k, ¬ (lr i k ∨ lr k i)) ∧ (∀ j, ∃ l, ¬ (lc j l ∨ lc l j)) ∧
    ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ PEqualNP.Represents.Represents A C ∧
      C.size ≤ n+m-1 ∧ ∃ g ∈ C.gates, g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not
  let iso := fun (A B : Fin n → Fin m → Bool) =>
    ∃ (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (f : Equiv.Perm (Fin m)), ∀ i j, A i j = B (e i) (f j)
  let count := if min n m < 4 then 0 else if n = m then (if n = 4 then 1 else 2)
               else if n+1 = m ∨ m+1 = n then 1 else 0
  ∃ family : Fin count → Fin n → Fin m → Bool,
    (∀ i, good (family i)) ∧ (∀ i j, iso (family i) (family j) → i = j) ∧
    (∀ A, good A → ∃ i, iso A (family i))
